universal.label: UAE Police & Unified Emergency Dispatch
universal.description: Primary UAE emergency number connecting to Police Command & Control across all seven emirates (Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman, UAQ, RAK, Fujairah).

categories.name: Police & Coastguard
categories.description: 999 Emergency Police, 901 Non-Emergency Police, and 996 Coastguard.

numbers.label: Police Emergency Command Center
numbers.audience: Residents, tourists, and motorists facing immediate danger, serious road accidents, or crime.
numbers.whenToUse: Call 999 immediately for any emergency requiring rapid police patrol or road crash dispatch.

numbers.label: Police Non-Emergency Call Center
numbers.audience: Residents with general police inquiries, minor traffic documentation, or non-urgent reports.
numbers.whenToUse: Dial 901 instead of 999 when there is no immediate threat to life or safety.

numbers.label: UAE Coastguard Maritime Rescue
numbers.audience: Boaters, swimmers, and mariners facing distress in UAE territorial waters.
numbers.whenToUse: Call 996 immediately for marine search and rescue or vessel emergencies.

categories.name: Medical & Ambulance
categories.description: National Ambulance & Dubai Corporation for Ambulance Services (998).

numbers.label: UAE Emergency Ambulance
numbers.audience: Anyone experiencing a medical emergency, trauma, cardiac event, or severe injury.
numbers.whenToUse: Dial 998 directly for immediate paramedic ambulance dispatch across any emirate.

categories.name: Fire & Civil Defence
categories.description: UAE Civil Defence firefighting and urban rescue (997).

numbers.label: UAE Civil Defence (Fire & Rescue)
numbers.audience: Anyone reporting building fires, vehicle fires, gas leaks, or trapped persons.
numbers.whenToUse: Evacuate immediately and dial 997 to dispatch Civil Defence fire engines.

categories.name: Women & Child Safety
categories.description: Ministry of Interior Child Protection and Dubai Foundation for Women and Children.

numbers.label: MoI Child Protection Centre Hotline
numbers.audience: Children at risk or anyone reporting child abuse, neglect, or exploitation in the UAE.
numbers.whenToUse: Call to report any form of child abuse directly to the Ministry of Interior Child Protection Centre.

numbers.label: Dubai Foundation for Women and Children (DFWAC)
numbers.audience: Women and children experiencing domestic violence, abuse, or human trafficking.
numbers.whenToUse: Call 800 111 for immediate shelter, protection, and confidential crisis support.

categories.name: Cyber Crime & Utilities
categories.description: eCrime / Aman Service cyber reporting and 991 emergency utility failure.

numbers.label: Aman Service (Security & Cyber Threat Reporting)
numbers.audience: Residents reporting cyber extortion, online fraud, or security threats confidentially.
numbers.whenToUse: Call 800 2626 (AMAN) or use the eCrime portal (901 in Dubai) to report cybercrime in Arabic, English, or Urdu.

numbers.label: Emergency Electricity & Water Failure
numbers.audience: Residents facing sudden power outages or burst water mains during extreme heat or storms.
numbers.whenToUse: Dial 991 for emergency electricity and water utility dispatch.
